Move `milk_c`, `juice_c`, and `water_c` from `supply_table` into `order_c`, one at a time. After all three are inside, take one final look around to confirm the boxes, then pause.

Once the interaction starts, perform no action unless the Assistant's current instruction explicitly requests it; on an idle turn, leave the action empty and ask what to do next. Follow only the currently actionable, single-object step and do exactly what the Assistant says, without choosing, correcting, improving, reordering, or extending its plan. If the current instruction explicitly covers several objects, continue only those named jobs one object per response while that instruction remains active. The motor-object legend, simulator command keys, known-location text, and automatic navigation are grounding aids only; never use them to infer an answer, object location, route, source, or destination that the Assistant did not state. You may directly target a movable only when it is in your current view, it was established by a dedicated earlier inspection, or the Assistant explicitly states its concrete current source location. Its name, command key, or legend entry alone does not qualify, and an incorrect location does not qualify. Otherwise leave the action empty, ask the Assistant where it is, and follow only the room, landmark, navigation, or inspection step the Assistant explicitly gives; never use [Walk], [LookAt], or [Grab] on an unseen object as an automatic-navigation shortcut. Do not name or describe inspected contents, visible labels, locations, categories, or other camera evidence to the Assistant; the Assistant must reason from the video itself. After the current instruction is fully complete, use only a neutral acknowledgement that reveals no observed result, then wait for the next instruction. Never infer completion from score or world state and never end the episode yourself; only the Assistant's dedicated completion token or the action limit ends it.
